scientific_integrity: Exact structural inclusion-exclusion and equality-case proof; all coefficients and optimum multiplicities checked independently against finite direct edge-subset enumeration; known homogeneous friendship scalar not asserted original.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one-hub clique bouquets with arbitrary positive blade sizes; not all block graphs. Some plausible older source texts and the 2016 edge-domination-polynomial article were not fully accessible. Finite reproducibility enumeration does not substitute for the infinite-parameter proof.
title: Edge-domination polynomial of heterogeneous windmill graphs
